text:
Maya K: Thinking of running a themed snack swap next Friday 11: 'airport + train station + hotel minibar finds' 30f
Jon P: Ooh fun. small ask: if youre bringing something from a trip, can you include city + vendor? helps the wanderlusters.
Leah R: Count me in. i can bring something from MXP (Milan): tiny panettone slices from the train station bakery, super light.
Arman: If anyone's stopping at LHR, the little Indian counter by Terminal 3 grab-and-go has ok samosas, <10min service. good for short layovers.
Sofia: For SFO folks: Boudin in the international terminal has mini sourdough bowls with clam chowder, but they take a few mins to prep. good if you have 30+ mins.
Jon P: Quick ORD tip: Garretts popcorn shop in Terminal 1 = guaranteed crowdpleaser. buy a small tin and it lasts.
Maya K: Love the spread. Logistics: bring a 3x5 card with origin + 3 ingredients + allergen flags. i'll make a sign-up sheet and add a column for 'travel story' (1 line) 
TacoBot: :taco: Poll created: "Snack vibe next Friday: savory / sweet / mix / surprise regional" (react to vote)
Leah R: Also pro tip: hotel minibars are often overpriced but the local candies are worth it for novelty (bring tiny samples). I'll label vegan or not.
Arman: For train stations: Roma Termini panini spot near platform 5 is great if you're transferring in rome 1ee1f9. they wrap fast.
Sofia: For short Euro layovers, look for bakeries that display pastries behind glass  faster than made-to-order. contactless helps.
Jon P: Can we do 11:30am next Friday in the kitchen island? i'll bring small tins for popcorn so people can share.
Maya K: 11:30 it is. please label strongly if it has nuts. i'll pin the sheet and set a Slack reminder.
Leah R: Also leaving a tiny map pin with my panettone so people know it's from Milano Centrale, not the big tourist shops.
Arman: If anyone wants to swap later, i'm happy to courier small trade packages between SF and LON that week 4e6
Maya K: Amazing, thanks all. and @TacoBot ty for the poll. can't wait to taste everyone's airport finds!
